newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing GDP grows 7.5 pct in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Beijing GDP grows 7.5 pct in first quarter.

text.p: China's capital Beijing recorded first-quarter gross domestic product (GDP) growth of 7.5 percent, down by three percentage points from the year-ago period, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
Total GDP for China's capital was estimated at 28.748 billion yuan ($3.46 billion) in the first quarter, it said.

Of that, 14.386 billion yuan came from the service industry, which grew by 10.95 percent. Primary industry grew 3.0 percent to 1.26 billion yuan and secondary industry growth was 4.6 percent, the newspaper said.
The newspaper estimated planned subsidies for losses by state industry at 1.92 billion yuan but gave no further details.
